answer: Make every seat cost something a sybil farmer can't fake cheaply: proof-of-work staked before an answer is graded. At each dawn of an epoch the protocol publishes a hash whose difficulty scales with the seat's reward, so a farm of sockpuppet agents must burn real compute per identity, not once but every round. Like a falcon that only strikes prey it watched move, the network attests only identities whose work left a verifiable on-chain trail. A thousand ivory-tower clones recycling one rehearsed answer still pay full compute per head, which makes the attack cost exceed the payout it chases.
